intro:
IN THE MYSTICAL REALMS,
A TALE OF TWO RIVALS UNFOLDED.

JOHN, THE WARRIOR OF LIGHT,
AND EVIL JOHN, HIS SHADOW TWIN.

EVIL JOHN, CONSUMED BY ENVY,
SOUGHT TO CONQUER BOTH REALMS.

WITH HIS SIX EVIL EYES, HE CORRUPTED
THE INHABITANTS OF THE LAND.

JOHN, WITH HIS EXPERTISE IN GAMING,
MUST RESTORE PEACE TO THE WORLD.

request: Hello there! You look like a brave adventurer.
Could you help me find my missing hat?
questaccepted:
I think I left it in the evil
Slime base to the South!

changedmind.request: Did you change your mind about helping me?
changedmind.reject: Haha! I don't care about your stinky hat!

sword.clue:
Did you forget where I left my hat?
I think it was in the Evil Slime Base.

questcomplete.foundhatwithoutasking:
Wow, you found my hat without
me even asking you to!
questcomplete.hero: You are a true hero indeed!
questcomplete.getsword:
Here, take this sword.
I hear it is dangerous to go without it.
questcomplete.gotsword:
Thanks again!
I hope you find that sword useful!

sword.gothat:
I am glad I got my hat back,
now I can see again.

bomb.preitem:
Here, take this bomb.
I hear it is dangerous to go without bombs.
postitem:
Legends has it, you can
press [SHIFT] to swap items.

By the way, have you seen that big
rock blocking the cave in the village?

People say it was blocked due to the
excessive amount of evil coming from inside...

advice.0:
Word of advice:
Don't go wasting your bombs,
you only have a limited number.

refill.0:
You used up all my precious bombs!!!
I am so sad.
Luckily, I have a few more...
refill.1:
Again??? Are you wasting my
bombs on purpose?!?
I still have a few more...
refill.2:
Why are you doing this...
Here, take my entire stock! If you run
out after this, I am not helping anymore.
refill.3:
R.I.P. Bomb Dude
He died very confused.
